entries.headline: Eight US cargo aircraft and coded USAF broadcast reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported six US military cargo aircraft airborne over the United States and two more over the North Sea, with one coded US Air Force radio broadcast heard in the preceding hour.

entries.headline: EAM header code VQSKKX reported
entries.summary: War Watch posted an Emergency Action Message header/preamble alert with header code VQSKKX.

entries.headline: Czech Air Force A319 CEF05F reported over Persian Gulf
entries.summary: War Watch reported Czech Air Force Airbus A319 CEF05F, hex 498421 and registration 3085, over the Persian Gulf. The aircraft report was credited to reagan0965.

entries.headline: Six US transports and normal coded radio traffic reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported six US Air Force transport aircraft airborne over the United States and said coded US Air Force radio broadcasts continued at normal frequency.

entries.headline: E-6 Mercury aircraft reported without callsign
entries.summary: War Watch reported a Boeing E-6 Mercury aircraft with no callsign and hex AF6BC4. The aircraft report was credited to reagan0965.

entries.headline: US transports and major Riyadh airport incident reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported multiple US Air Force transport aircraft airborne over the continental United States and said reports indicated a major incident at Riyadh airport with dozens dead. The visible post is truncated after the word “hundreds”.

entries.headline: Six US transports, elevated East Asia activity and Riyadh strike reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported six US Air Force transport aircraft airborne over the continental United States, military activity near Korea and Japan at three times normal levels, and a Houthi missile strike on Riyadh airport. The visible post is truncated after the word “kills”.

entries.headline: Riyadh airport casualties, Jeddah diversions and regional tanker reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported that a Houthi missile attack on Riyadh airport killed 12 people and injured 300, with flights diverted to Jeddah while a US military refuelling tanker operated in the region.

entries.headline: US transports and widespread Saudi flight disruption reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported multiple large US military transport aircraft airborne over the continental United States and said attacks on Saudi airports caused dozens of deaths, widespread flight diversions and delays. The visible post is truncated thereafter.

entries.headline: Six US transports and continuing Saudi airport disruption reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported six US Air Force transport aircraft airborne, including one over the North Sea, and said Saudi airports remained disrupted after Houthi attacks on a Riyadh terminal killed 12 people and injured 300.

entries.headline: US transports, elevated Mediterranean traffic and Saudi attacks reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported multiple US military transport aircraft airborne over the continental United States, Eastern Mediterranean air traffic at nearly four times normal and Houthi attacks on Saudi airports. The visible post is truncated after the word “major”.

entries.headline: US surveillance aircraft and Riyadh airport casualties reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported a US Air Force surveillance aircraft operating over northern Saudi Arabia and said missile impacts at Riyadh airport killed 12 people and injured 300. The visible post is truncated after stating that multiple airports remained closed or otherwise affected.

entries.headline: E-6 airborne alert at Suisun

entries.headline: SkyGlass shares report on B-52 LRASM integration
entries.summary: SkyGlass shared a The Aviationist report that the B-52 Stratofortress is set to integrate the AGM-158C LRASM.

entries.headline: P-8 airborne alert at Whitecourt
entries.summary: SkyGlass posted an OFF Ground alert for a military P-8 aircraft at Whitecourt, Canada. The callsign was shown as NA.

entries.headline: E-2 GRYHK61 airborne alert at Forestville
